name: Brigadoone Front Lawn and Gardens
description: Take a look at this beautifully curated Florence front yard. We worked with the homeowner on the design and gave the yard a completely new look, with new beds, plants, trees, mulch, a full regrade of the slope, irrigation, and sod. At night, the lighting brings out the front of the home, the walk, and the trees.
metaDescription: A beautifully curated Florence front yard with new beds, plants, trees, mulch, a regraded slope, irrigation, sod, and night lighting.
story: The front yard in Brigadoone was redone from the lawn out. We installed the turf and mow it in stripes. The beds follow the driveway and the walk, with mulch, seasonal color, a crepe myrtle, and shrubs we prune so they stay in shape. After dark, lights come on across the front, the steps, and the trees. Sprinklers water the lawn and the beds, and the yard is graded toward the street so rain doesn't sit in the grass. We stay on it after the install, with mowing, turf treatment, bed work, pruning, cleanup, and new color through the year.
